title: All sorts of diets
objectives: use countable and uncountable grocery terms with a/an, some, any

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for All sorts of diets.
Welcome to today's lesson: All sorts of diets! Today we will practice how to use countable and uncountable grocery terms with a/an, some, any.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for All sorts of diets:
use countable and uncountable grocery terms with a/an, some, any; discuss dietary choices

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: bread, cheese, butter, meat, chicken, fish

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Which item is uncountable in English?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Do we have any milk? We have some bread and cheese, but we need fresh fruit.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
On my diet, I eat fresh fruit and vegetables. I have some cheese and bread, but no meat.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Talk about your usual food shopping list and dietary habits.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: use countable and uncountable grocery terms with a/an, some, any, discuss dietary choices.
